A34-08.note: Fixed after the audit's handoff. (1) [UninstallDelete] now lists every {app} name [InstallDelete] clears, with the same type (*.dll, fiorivoce*.exe, .fiorivoce-update.json, .fiorivoce-update-complete, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md; licenses, platforms, styles, imageformats, iconengines, tls, generic, networkinformation, share, webui), plus the updates folder, as OpenWhisper's installer lists _internal, its programs, the manifest and the sentinel; nothing names unins*, {app} itself, the data folder, speech-models or the updater's .new-/.old-/.failed- siblings, and Inno removes the emptied {app}. The names were checked against update/update_contract.h (manifest and sentinel) and update_native/manifest.h (fiorivoce-updater.exe). test_upgrade_keeps_user_data_outside_the_replaced_install_tree now checks that the only {localappdata} entry is the updates folder, and test_uninstall_removes_the_install_names_a_native_update_left_unlogged pins the two lists equal. (2) [InstallDelete] is kept as a recorded decision against M10.17 change 8: the helper's prepare only copies managed files aside and never deletes a retired one, and an elevated setup (IsAdmin) runs no helper; a comment above the section and a paragraph in packaging/windows/README.md say so, pinned by test_install_delete_stays_as_a_recorded_decision. (3) packaging/windows/smoke-update.ps1 written per M10.17: installs 0.1.0 into a temporary folder with LOCALAPPDATA pointed at a temporary folder for every child, serves 0.1.1 and a 0.1.2 started with FIORIVOCE_TEST_FAIL_HEALTH=1 through serve_update_feed.py on 127.0.0.1, waits for the update and the rollback, uninstalls and checks the install folder is gone; it refuses without -OnThisComputer, on CI, elevated, with FioriVoce installed or running or a recovery pending, and refuses a 0.1.2 whose fiorivoce.exe lacks FIORIVOCE_TEST_FAIL_HEALTH (no source file in src/ reads that variable yet: M10.12's switch is missing). SmokeUpdateScript in test_windows_installer.py pins it statically (its parse check skips without PowerShell). Nothing here has been executed on Windows: no ISCC compile, no install, no uninstall, no smoke-update.ps1 run.

A34-15.note: Fixed after the audit's handoff, per lead decision 8. .github/workflows/qualify-release.yml written: workflow_dispatch only (candidate_run_id, release_tag, require_windows_signed), top-level contents: read, both jobs under if: vars.FIORIVOCE_RELEASE_REPO != '' (and the variable must name the repository it runs in). qualify (actions: read, contents: read) checks the candidate run is a successful hand-started release-build.yml run of this repository, downloads fiorivoce-release-candidate and runs check_release_qualification.py --require-source-qualification --expected-commit <tag commit> --expected-run <run>; upload (needs qualify, contents: write) repeats that on the bytes it uploads, checks the tag is v<version> at that commit and the release is a draft holding nothing the candidate does not replace, validates --draft-assets, runs gh release upload --clobber and re-validates with --uploaded.
